title: Beit Natzeh

paragraphs: In [Kiddushin 40b](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.40b.8): Rabbi Tarfon and the elders were once reclining in the upper chamber of Beit Natzeh in Lod; Rabbi Tarfon spoke up—Rabbi Akiva spoke up, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The linked episode places Rabbi Tarfon and Rabbi Akiva in the upper chamber of Beit Natzeh in Lod. Tarfon says action is greater; Akiva says study is greater. Hyman cites the opening and abbreviates the rest.
